seo.webpageTitle: “Bhaiya, Are You Yash Bhavsar?”: My First Talk to Juniors — The Dev Notebook
seo.metaDescription: How a junior’s question at my hostel became my first guidance talk for first-year AIML and CO students: the nerves, the blank moment, what I told them about learning online, and why the only way past the fear of speaking is to face it.

content.title: “Bhaiya, Are You Yash Bhavsar?”: My First Talk to My Juniors
content.dek: A stranger in the hostel, a long night of thinking, and a talk that took me out of my comfort zone.
